headline: Ricardo Marques unbeaten after eleven saves
dek: Florida Southern's third win came at Delta State, their first away from home, and it was as clean as the two before it. Four different players have scored their ten goals; nobody has scored against them, and every other side in the conference has conceded.
displaced_by: Florida Southern's third win, at Delta State, still without conceding; the old line counted two

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Eckerd, Florida Tech, Barry and Nova Southeastern put together, and have done it without conceding.

wire.line: Rollins have conceded more goals than any other side in the conference and have still not lost.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: The record carries no score gap today. Three matches have passed their date with no result at all, and all three are Palm Beach Atlantic's, among them the match against Barry, a fellow member.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored three of Palm Beach Atlantic's five goals, from seventeen shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic have not won since their opening match against Lincoln Memorial: draws at home to Carson-Newman and at Young Harris, then defeat at North Georgia.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Trent Murphy has made fifteen saves for Eckerd and conceded six, with no clean sheet yet.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Embry-Riddle are unbeaten after a draw at Spring Hill, and six different players have scored for them, the widest spread of scorers in the conference.

last_match.line: Palm Beach Atlantic have not won since their opening match; North Georgia have yet to concede against a side from this conference.

next_match.line: Clayton State have already beaten Barry and drawn at Tampa; Florida Tech have not lost since their opening match.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
